conclusions: The page rendered the initial banner, but storage/workspace initialization did not finish.
No worker error was surfaced by the SharedWorker variants. The dedicated variant also timed out during script evaluation.
These results do not establish the precise engine defect; a focused protocol/Worker reproduction is still required.
Do not ship a global Worker monkey patch or silently keep the dev server as production.
Native storage remains a Rust SQLite requirement; browser IndexedDB is probe-only.
